notes: UX round 2 round C plus the first round D feature. Round C rebuilt the public copy on the product's twelve traits (a real install command, no stale download promise, no Chinese in an English session), restyled the site around the water-drop identity, and rebuilt the console's Settings as a two-tier Guided/Advanced surface: a plain-language Overview state sentence derived only from live seams, a collapsed TECHNICAL DETAILS block, a sticky save bar that names the unsaved card and mirrors the save row verbatim, and an English session that stays Chinese-free. Round D car 1 adds one-click model discovery: the Model card reads the endpoint's model directory (GET /models — a read-only listing, it never spends a token and never reaches a completion), renders the ids as a checkable list with select-all, and appends the picked ids into the existing whitelist so the normal save path stays the single writer. The optional API key travels only as that endpoint's Authorization header — never echoed, never logged, never stored; an empty key uses the saved key for the configured endpoint and no key anywhere else, and a failure answers with an HTTP status or an exception class instead of a URL or a body line.
